purpose: The long-form prose body of the four section.tech pages: headings, paragraphs, ordered and unordered lists, anchor indexes and tables.

structure.anchorIndex: an <ol role="list"> of in-page <a href="#slug"> links, one per h2
structure.anchorTargets: each h2 carries BOTH id="slug" and a preceding empty <div id="slug"> inside a .w-embed wrapper - the duplicate id is how Webflow's rich-text anchors work and it is reproduced verbatim
structure.tables: optional; cells use .tech__rich-cell with a .is-head modifier for the header row

props.headings: h2 at the anchor level, h3 for sub-sections

responsive.base: single column under an 8rem top offset with 2rem side gutters
responsive.max-991px: heading.sub (via the .tech__title override to type.h1) drops 5.5rem -> 4.5rem
responsive.max-767px: heading.sub drops to 2.5rem and body.lead to 1rem

notes: EVIDENCE LEVEL: the DOM scaffolding of this component on /privacy-policy and /terms-of-service was measured against the live original (privacy h1:1 h2:12 h3:2 p:39 li:31 a:15 table:2 tr:25 td:105; terms h1:1 h2:16 h3:1 p:63 li:30 a:21 - all independently re-counted from the real JSX and matching exactly). The PROSE ITSELF IS DELIBERATE PLACEHOLDER FILLER, not the original's copy. Any word budget derived from these pages measures the filler. That is why this component declares NO maxWords on its paragraph slots and why sections/content-tech.json budgets only the headings and labels.
